name: cancel-readback
title: Cancel Readback
description: The cancel screen reads back the exact date and time access ends, what is lost and kept, and the refund (or plainly that there is none), offers pause or downgrade once below a cancel button that never moves, and ends on a receipt with undo.

meta.stops: Cancelled without knowing when access ends
meta.summary: Reads back exactly when access ends, what is lost and what is refunded before someone cancels, and ends on a receipt with an undo.
meta.server: Cancel and resume on the server and compute access end and refunds from billing records, not from what the screen showed.
catches: Cancelling without knowing when access actually ends (date, time, zone and days left)
Unclear refunds, by stating the refund or that there is none
Dark-pattern retention: alternatives appear once, below a cancel button that stays put
Regret, with a resume action on the receipt
limits: Shows the access end, refund and items you pass; it does not compute them
Cancelling and resuming happen in your callbacks
a11y: The receipt is announced with role="status"
Lost and kept items use icons plus text
